ig4.hint: Steps: 1) pick the dataset type (style/character) and, if style, set art_style above  2) double-click an image to draw boxes  3) press Start to capture and export.
ig4.no_jobs: Draw boxes on at least one image first (double-click).
ig4.is_character: Character dataset — the VLM infers each image's style
ig4.tip.is_character: Style = one global art_style for the whole set (best for a consistent style LoRA). Character = the subject appears in many styles, so the VLM infers the style of each image individually.
ig4.infer_style: Infer the global style with the VLM
ig4.canvas_help: Drag on the image to draw a box. Click a box to select it, then drag its corners to resize or its body to move it. Only the selected box moves. Wheel = zoom, middle-button drag = pan. Arrow keys move the box (Shift = 10 px); Ctrl+D duplicates it.
ig4.tip.canvas: Drawing area. Empty space = draw a new box; on a box = select/move/resize. Wheel = zoom, middle-button drag = pan.
ig4.tip.type_obj: Object: a visual element (character, prop, panel, frame). On Start the VLM describes it and k-means extracts its colors.
ig4.tip.type_text: Text: literal words in the image (titles, dialog). You type the exact string; it is ground truth and never sent to the VLM.
ig4.tip.list: Every box you draw. Order = prominence: #1 is the most salient. Drag rows to reorder — it matters for the caption. Text boxes are moved to the end automatically on export.
ig4.tip.delete: Remove the selected box from the list and the image.
ig4.tip.elem_text: The exact words shown in this text box (ground truth). Enabled only for 'text' elements.
ig4.tip.elem_desc: Short description of this element. For objects the VLM fills it on Start if empty; anything you write here is kept (not overwritten).
ig4.tip.compose_text: Render NEW text onto the image (titles, flyers), optionally inside a speech bubble. The box and color become ground truth. Select a 'text' element first.
ig4.tip.compose_shape: Draw a frame, panel or speech-bubble shape onto the image. Select an 'object' element first.
ig4.tip.hld: One or two sentences describing the whole scene. The VLM fills this on Start if you leave it empty.
ig4.tip.background: Describes ONLY the background. The VLM fills this on Start if empty.
ig4.tip.aesthetics: Optional. Mood/aesthetics of the set's style (e.g. 'clean studio').
ig4.tip.lighting: Optional. Lighting of the set's style (e.g. 'soft key light').
ig4.tip.art_style: REQUIRED to export. This image's art style. In a style dataset it is inherited from the panel (keep it identical across the set); in a character dataset the VLM fills it per image on Start if you leave it empty.
ig4.tip.save: Save boxes and fields to the work file (.pano.json) and close the editor. You can reopen and continue later; capture (Start) reads these files.
ig4.tip.align: Snap the text block to this position on the image (fine-tune with x / y).
ig4.tip.close: Close the editor discarding unsaved changes since the last save.
ig4.tip.set_artstyle: REQUIRED in Style mode. The art style shared by the whole set. Write it once; it is inherited by every image. Keep it identical so the LoRA learns a single consistent style. (Or leave it to the VLM with 'Infer the global style'.)
ig4.tip.set_aesthetics: Optional. Shared mood/aesthetics (e.g. 'clean studio, soft palette').
ig4.tip.set_lighting: Optional. Shared lighting (e.g. 'soft three-point key light').
ig4.tip.padding: Extra margin added around each object box before it is cropped and sent to the VLM. More padding = more surrounding context, but less isolation.
ig4.tip.prompt_hld: Instruction sent to the VLM to describe the whole image (high_level_description). Edit only if you know what you want.
ig4.tip.prompt_bg: Instruction sent to the VLM to describe only the background.
ig4.tip.prompt_obj: Instruction sent to the VLM for each object crop (its 'desc'). Applied per object box.
ig4.tip.prompt_style: Used whenever the VLM infers the style (character dataset, or style dataset with 'Infer the global style'). Asks the VLM for art_style/aesthetics/lighting; the reply is parsed into those fields.
ig4.tip.infer_style: Style mode only. OFF: you type art_style by hand. ON: the VLM reads one image, derives art_style/aesthetics/lighting and reuses the SAME style for the whole set — still consistent, just automatic.
ig4.tip.recapture: OFF (resume): only empty fields are captured, so re-running is cheap and won't re-spend the VLM. ON: re-asks the VLM and overwrites everything already captured.
ig4.artstyle_missing_msg: {0} image(s) have no art_style and cannot be exported (it is required). Fill art_style in the panel before drawing, or in each box editor, enable 'Infer the global style', or switch to a character dataset. Continue and skip them?
ig4.tip.tx_text: The exact words to render (this becomes the element's ground-truth text).
ig4.tip.tx_font: Typeface. Bundled OFL/Apache fonts — same look on any machine.
ig4.tip.tx_effect: Layout style: straight, arc, wave, circle, perspective, tilt or vertical.
ig4.tip.tx_strength: Intensity of the chosen effect (curvature/amplitude/angle). Disabled for Straight and Vertical.
ig4.tip.tx_stroke: Outline thickness around the glyphs (0 = none). Helps readability over busy images.
ig4.tip.tx_pos: Top-left X position of the text block, in pixels.
ig4.tip.tx_pos_y: Top-left Y position of the text block, in pixels.
ig4.tip.tx_color: Glyph color. Saved as the element's ground-truth color (#RRGGBB).
ig4.tip.tx_frame: Optional shape drawn BEHIND the text (speech bubble for dialog). It auto-wraps the text.
ig4.tip.tx_frame_fill: Fill the frame with a solid color so the text reads on top (on by default for bubbles).
ig4.tip.tx_apply: Bake the text (and frame) onto the output copy and return. The box is computed automatically.
ig4.tip.sh_shape: Frame type: rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, or speech bubble (with tail).
ig4.tip.sh_x: Top-left X of the shape, in pixels.
ig4.tip.sh_y: Top-left Y of the shape, in pixels.
ig4.tip.sh_radius: Corner roundness (rounded rectangle and bubble only).
ig4.tip.sh_tail_x: Speech-bubble tail tip X — point it toward the speaker (bubble only).
ig4.tip.sh_fill: Fill the shape with a solid color (e.g. white bubble so text reads).
ig4.tip.sh_fill_color: Fill color (used when Fill is on).
ig4.tip.sh_apply: Bake the shape onto the output copy and return. The box is computed automatically.
ig4.tip.zoom_fit: Fit the whole image in the view
ig4.auto_none: No objects detected. Draw the boxes by hand.
ig4.tip.auto_detect: Detect characters, animals and objects with YOLO and add them as boxes (type 'object', no description: the VLM captures it on Start). Review and adjust them: resize, add missing ones, or delete extras. Text is still drawn by hand.
ig4.tip.batch_detect: Run YOLO over every image in the set and save a draft .pano.json with detected objects (no description: the VLM captures it on Start). Images that already have boxes are left untouched. Then double-click each image to review and adjust.
ig4.tip.text_color: Current text color (ground truth). Click to pick it by hand.
ig4.tip.eyedropper: Sample the EXACT color of existing text: click here, then click the glyph on the image. The sampled hex becomes this text's color.
ig4.tip.prev: Save and go to the previous image (Alt+←).
ig4.tip.next: Save and go to the next image (Alt+→).
cherry.legacy_note_short: Only merging projects still needs the classic window.
cherry.delete_profile_tip: Removes it from the index. The downloaded folder is left untouched.
cherry.settings_workers_tip: Default only: each site's template caps it, and the download view can ask for a different number.
cherry.settings_note: Changing the download folder does not move anything: existing projects keep the path they were created with, and only new ones land here. Saved to {file}, shared with the standalone cherry-dl.
cherry.settings_dir_empty: The download folder cannot be empty.
cherry.settings_dir_missing: “{f}” does not exist. Create it first, or pick another one.
cherry.dups_intro: Two projects sharing a source are the same artist added twice — that one is a certainty, not a guess. A similar name is only a suspicion. Merging is not done here: it moves files between folders on disk.
cherry.dups_not_same_tip: The pair stops showing up, here and in cherry-dl.
cherry.dups_source_tip: Both projects download the same artist from the same site.
cherry.dups_none: No suspicious pairs. {n} pairs are already marked as different.
cherry.dups_found: {n} pairs to review · {e} already marked as different.
cherry.dups_excluded: Marked as different. {n} pairs left to review.
cherry.dups_merge_tip: Turns the two projects into one: the older keeps its folder and receives what the other has and it lacks. Shows the numbers before moving anything — but once confirmed there is no undo.
cherry.dups_close_tip: Closes the list. Nothing is left running.
cherry.merge_why_keep: The older project is the one that stays — cherry-dl decides that, it is not a choice. Its folder is the one that keeps growing.
cherry.merge_paths_tip: Top: the folder that receives the files. Bottom: the one left behind.
cherry.merge_n_move_tip: Unique to the project being absorbed: nothing in the destination has the same content.
cherry.merge_n_dup_tip: Same content, byte for byte. They do not move — you choose below what happens to them.
cherry.merge_n_missing_tip: The catalogue mentions them but the file is gone. They are skipped.
cherry.merge_n_untracked_tip: Files sitting in the folder that cherry-dl never registered. Nothing moves or deletes them: they stay where they are, even if the folder is emptied.
cherry.merge_orphan_q: What to do with the {n} already in the destination:
cherry.merge_orphan_keep_tip: Nothing is deleted. The folder stays with its copies — the safe choice if you want to check the result first.
cherry.merge_orphan_rename_tip: Marks the leftover folder without deleting anything, so it is easy to find and remove later.
cherry.merge_orphan_delete_tip: Deletes the copies for good — not to the recycle bin. The folder itself goes too if nothing else is left in it.
cherry.merge_warn: ⚠ Merging moves files on disk and cannot be undone.
cherry.merge_unreadable: ⚠ The catalogue of the project to absorb could not be read. Nothing will be merged.
cherry.merge_go_tip: Moves the files and merges the two projects into one. No undo.
cherry.merge_done: ✓ Merged into {keep} · {moved} files moved, {dup} were already there.
cherry.merge_failed: Merge stopped and nothing was merged — both projects are intact. {msg}
cherry.detail_gone: Profile no longer in the index.
cherry.no_index: No index found at ~/.cherry-dl/index.db — create a profile in the classic GUI first.
cherry.runtime_failed: Could not start the async runtime.
cherry.ext_custom_tip: Extra extensions on top of the boxes above, comma separated.
cherry.ext_hint_none: Select a project to choose its file types.
cherry.ext_hint_all: Nothing selected: every file type is downloaded.
cherry.ext_apply_all_tip: Copy these types to every project currently listed.
cherry.ext_apply_all_body: {n} listed projects will download only these {e} extensions. Their current selection is replaced.
cherry.ext_apply_all_body_none: {n} listed projects will go back to downloading every file type. Their current selection is replaced.
cherry.ext_applied_all: File types applied to the listed projects.
cherry.scan_tip: Look for new files and queue them, without downloading.
cherry.batch_body: {n} profiles will be synced one after another. It can take hours and hits the sites in sequence; you can cancel at any point.
cherry.auth_body:
{site} needs an active session. Without one, only free public posts would be downloaded.

Log in now? Your real browser will open so you can sign in; the download resumes by itself afterwards.
cherry.new_resolve_failed: Could not fetch the name ({msg}) — type it by hand and create anyway.
cherry.add_url_hint: Everything lands in the same folder as the profile. Its first sync scans the whole history of the new source.
cherry.dup_url: ⚠ This URL is already a source of: {names}
cherry.known_artist: ℹ The library already has {n} files by “{a}” in {w}.
lib.backfill_tip: Compute the SHA-256 content identity of files that lack it (cherry-dl folders get theirs from catalog.db). Resumable.
settings.back_tip: Back to the dashboard. Nothing in progress is cancelled and the tool keeps its state.
cherry.new_profile_tip: Registers a project: name, target folder and its first source. Downloads nothing yet.
cherry.search_ph_tip: Filters the list by project name or by its folder on disk. Does not search inside files.
cherry.site_filter_tip: Shows only the projects from one site (Patreon, Pixiv…).
cherry.only_missing_tip: Leaves only the projects whose folder is gone from disk — typical after moving files or unplugging a drive.
cherry.download_all_tip: Downloads EVERY project currently listed, one after another, honouring the filter you have set. It can take hours; you can cancel at any point.
cherry.dups_open_tip: Looks for projects pointing at the same source or with near-identical names. It only reports: it deletes and merges nothing.
cherry.settings_open_tip: Download folder, parallel workers and timeout. The network throttles deliberately stay in config.toml.
cherry.refresh_tip: Re-reads the index from disk. Useful if another program touched the projects.
cherry.add_url_tip: Adds another source URL to the selected project. One project can gather several sources into a single folder.
cherry.dl_workers_tip: How many files download at once. Each site has its own cap and the engine trims this number if you go over.
cherry.dl_rescan_tip: Goes through the whole project instead of resuming from the last sync. Much slower; use it when you suspect something old is missing.
cherry.download_tip: Downloads the new files of the selected project. When it finishes it tells the library to index them.
cherry.open_folder_tip: Opens the project's download folder in the file explorer.
cherry.cancel_tip: Stops the running download and the rest of the queue. Whatever already downloaded is kept.
pickler.open_folder_tip: Choose the folder of images to review. It is walked in order and nothing is changed until you decide on each image.
pickler.mode_tip: Switches the working MODE, it does not act on the current image. In «Keep» the big button keeps the image; in «Discard» it discards it. This is the top button: the bottom one is the one that acts.
pickler.choose_dest_tip: Folder where the images you keep end up. Discards do NOT go here: they go to «discarded» inside the source folder.
pickler.move_tip: The images you keep are MOVED to the destination: they leave the source folder.
pickler.copy_tip: The images you keep are COPIED to the destination: the original stays where it is.
pickler.undo_tip: Undoes ONLY the last decision and puts the image back. It is not a history: it does not chain several steps back.
pickler.open_dest_tip: Opens the folder where the images you keep are saved.
pickler.open_discarded_tip: Opens the source's «discarded» folder, where the discarded images are. They are still there: nothing was really deleted.
pickler.action_tip: Applies the current mode to the image on screen and moves to the next one. Discarding does NOT delete: it moves the file to «discarded», and it can be undone.
pickler.action_skip_tip: Moves to the next image without touching it or deciding anything about it.
wm.load_image_tip: Loads the image to stamp onto. The original file is never touched: the result is saved as a separate copy.
wm.load_wm_tip: Image tiled across the whole photo. Use a PNG with transparency so the background shows through.
wm.load_logo_tip: Image placed ONCE in a corner, on top of the tiled pattern. They are separate things: you can use just one of them.
wm.angle_tip: Tilt of the tiled pattern. A diagonal one is harder to crop out than a horizontal one.
wm.scale_tip: Size of each tile, from 10% to 200%. Bigger means fewer tiles, further apart.
wm.opacity_tip: How transparent the pattern is, from 0 to 100%. Under 20% it barely gets in the way, but it is also easier to remove.
wm.logo_pos_tip: Corner where the logo is placed.
wm.logo_size_tip: Logo width in pixels, from 50 to 500. It is a fixed size: it does not scale with the image, so on a small photo it looks proportionally bigger.
wm.save_copy_tip: Saves a copy with the mark applied. NOTE: it deliberately strips ALL metadata from the result (prompts, tags, EXIF), because these copies are meant for publishing. The original keeps its own.
tagger.browse_tip: Folder of images to caption. Captions are written as .txt files next to each image.
tagger.mode_tip: Which caption format is produced. «Both» yields TWO separate datasets, not one mixed text; «Ideogram v4» produces structured JSON and enables its own panel.
tagger.model_tags_tip: Instruction template for tags. It changes the prompt below: a starting point you can edit.
tagger.engine_tip: Who generates the tags. The WD tagger runs on your machine and gives real booru tags; the vision LLM makes them up from the image and depends on the endpoint.
tagger.wd_tagger_tip: Which WD model to use. Confidence thresholds are set by the preset and not exposed here: they are calibrated to prioritise the character.
tagger.wd_download_tip: Downloads the selected WD model if it is not on disk yet. It is several hundred MB and only needed once.
tagger.model_natural_tip: Instruction template for the natural-language text. It changes the prompt below, which you can edit.
tagger.endpoint_tip: Address of your local OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, Ollama…). Nothing is sent to the internet.
tagger.apikey_tip: Only if your server requires one. Most local servers do not need it.
tagger.discover_tip: Scans the usual ports on your machine for compatible servers and fills the address in for you.
tagger.test_tip: Checks that the address responds and fetches the list of models it offers, so you can pick one below.
tagger.endpoint_model_tip: The actual model that will serve the requests. It must be a vision model: if it is not, a warning appears just below.
tagger.trigger_tip: Unique word placed first in every caption, the one that will later trigger your LoRA. Best if it means nothing in English.
tagger.prefix_tip: Fixed text prepended to every caption, after the trigger word.
tagger.suffix_tip: Fixed text appended to the end of every caption.
tagger.policy_tip: What to do with images that ALREADY have a .txt: skip them, overwrite them or append. This is the difference between finishing a half-done folder and redoing it whole.
tagger.recursive_tip: Also walks into subfolders. On large folders it multiplies the work and the time.
tagger.reset_tags_tip: Resets THIS prompt (the tags one) to the chosen template's default text. Whatever you typed here is lost; the other prompt is untouched.
tagger.reset_natural_tip: Resets THIS prompt (the natural-language one) to the chosen template's default text. Whatever you typed here is lost; the other prompt is untouched.
tagger.review_tip: Opens the captions already generated to read and fix them by hand, image by image. It generates nothing new.
tagger.run_tip: Starts generating captions for the whole folder. It can take a long time: it goes image by image against the model.
tagger.cancel_tip: Stops the run. The captions already written stay on disk.
tagger.content_nsfw_tip: Adds a modifier to the prompt so the model describes explicit content without censoring itself. You will see it appear in the prompt editor below. The WD tagger ignores it: it already gives NSFW tags out of the box.
lib.add_tip: Registers a folder to watch. It copies nothing: it only notes where to look when indexing.
lib.remove_tip: Stops watching the folder and drops its files from the index. The files on disk are NOT touched.
lib.search_tip: Searches by name, tags and metadata text across the whole indexed library, not just the open folder.
lib.selection_action_tip: Which tool to send the selected images to. Pick here and press Execute.
lib.execute_tip: Sends the selection to the tool chosen in the dropdown next to it.
lib.purge_tip: Goes through the index and drops entries whose file is gone from disk. Useful after deleting or moving things outside the app. It deletes no files.
lib.run_indexer_tip: Walks the watched folders and adds whatever is new to the library. On a large library it takes a while; the same button stops it.
cr.load_folder_tip: Folder of images to look for known faces in.
cr.mode_illustration_tip: Mode for drawings and anime. Uses a detector trained on illustrated faces; it does worse on real photos.
cr.mode_real_tip: Mode for photography. Uses a detector trained on real faces; it does worse on drawings.
cr.auto_scan_tip: Goes through the whole folder recognising faces without asking one by one, then shows what it found for you to confirm.
cr.btn_yes_tip: Confirms the face is who it suggests and saves the tag. Shortcut: Enter.
cr.btn_manual_tip: Rejects the suggestion and lets you type the name by hand. Shortcut: Esc.
cr.btn_skip_tip: Moves to the next face without tagging this one.
cr.btn_return_tip: Back to the previous recognition screen.
cr.btn_save_tip: Saves the typed name and links it to this face.
cr.combo_names_tip: Characters already known. Pick one instead of typing it to avoid duplicates from a typo.
cr.btn_remove_tag_tip: Removes this tag from the image. The file itself is untouched.
cr.tag_all_tip: Applies the suggested name to ALL the faces the scan grouped as the same person, in one go.
cr.auto_cancel_tip: Stops the automatic scan. Whatever was tagged so far is kept.
cr.btn_back_tip: Goes back without saving the typed name.
crop.ar_tip: Locks the crop ratio. «Free» lets you drag as you like; the rest keep the shape fixed while you adjust.
crop.size_tip: Exact crop size in pixels. With a fixed ratio, changing one recomputes the other.
crop.save_tip: Saves the crop as a new file. The original is left alone, and its metadata is copied over to the crop.
fscanner.select_tip: Folder to analyse. It only counts formats and sizes to give you a report: it converts and touches nothing.
dup.mode_tip: How images are compared. Exact content only groups identical files; visual similarity also catches crops and recompressions, but it can get it wrong.
dup.threshold_tip: How alike two images must be to be grouped. Lowering it finds more matches and also more false positives.
dup.select_folder_tip: Folder to search for duplicates in.
dup.run_scan_tip: Analyses the folder and groups the repeated images. It deletes nothing: it just shows the groups for you to decide.
dup.auto_select_tip: It only TICKS the boxes: leaves the first of each group unticked and ticks the rest. It deletes nothing — the red button below is the one that does.
dup.delete_tip: Deletes the ticked files from disk PERMANENTLY: they do not go to the recycle bin. It warns first if you ticked every copy in some group.
opt.format_tip: Output format. WebP and AVIF weigh far less than JPEG at the same apparent quality, but not every program opens them.
opt.resize_tip: Whether to also shrink the pixel size on top of recompressing.
opt.max_side_tip: Limit for the longest side, in pixels. The aspect ratio is kept and images already smaller are not enlarged.
opt.preserve_meta_tip: Copies the original's prompts and generation data to the result. Without it, the optimised copy loses the image's «recipe».
opt.load_images_tip: Adds images to the queue. The originals are not modified: the result goes to a separate folder.
opt.analyze_tip: Looks at the queued images and suggests a format and size, without converting anything yet.
opt.process_tip: Converts the whole queue with the settings above and opens the result folder when it finishes.
meta.viewer_tip: Read-only: shows the prompts and generation data without letting you change them.
meta.editor_tip: Lets you edit the prompts. This is the only module that can write over the original file — that is what it is for.
meta.save_tip: OVERWRITES the original file with your edits. It asks for confirmation, and warns separately if you are about to leave it with no metadata: that erases the «recipe» and cannot be undone.
meta.export_tip: Saves a NEW file with the edited metadata and leaves the original untouched. It is the safe option next to «Save changes».
meta.open_tip: Loads one or more images to view or edit their metadata.
meta.prev_tip: Previous of the loaded images. Unsaved changes are lost.
meta.next_tip: Next of the loaded images. Unsaved changes are lost.
fc.select_folder_tip: Converts every image in a folder.
fc.add_files_tip: Adds individual files to the queue, on top of the folder or instead of it.
fc.recursive_tip: Also walks into the subfolders of the chosen folder.
fc.format_tip: Format to convert to. The originals are untouched: the result goes to a separate folder.
fc.preserve_meta_tip: Copies the original's prompts and generation data to the converted file. Without it they are lost in the conversion.
fc.verify_tip: After converting, re-reads each file and checks the metadata really made it. It is slower, but on large batches it is what stops you finding out too late.
fc.clear_queue_tip: Empties the list of manually added files. It deletes nothing from disk.
fc.convert_tip: Converts everything in the queue and opens the result folder when it finishes.
gallery.open_folder_tip: Opens a folder of images to browse here.
gallery.back_albums_tip: Back to the album view, leaving this folder's contents.
gallery.search_tip: Filters by tags or metadata text. Type several tags to keep only the images that have them all.
gallery.rating_tip: Leaves only the images with that rating or better.
gallery.clear_filters_tip: Clears the search and the rating at once, showing everything again.
gallery.picker_tip: Turns on multi-select so you can send several images to another tool. NOTE: turning it off clears whatever you had selected.
gallery.send_tip: Sends the selected images to another tool. Opens a menu to pick which one.
cherry.dl_site_blocked_log: ⛔ {site} refused {n} downloads in a row. The site is abandoned for this run; the files stay queued for another day.
